evidence.observation: H701 reads 285.6 °C versus H702 at 61.9 °C and reboiler at 52.5 °C, an unusually large heater-temperature discrepancy.
Discrepancy persists: H701 is 291.9 °C, H702 76.9 °C, and reboiler 68.3 °C; these readings do not distinguish actual overheating from a measurement fault.
Distillate flow is 0.5, reflux remains zero, and cooling-water flow is 5.8; whether zero reflux is intended requires the current protocol phase.
